annotations.text:
CURRENT (as built)
Warm cream, system font, cards with initials. Solid and readable, but the emoji chips and gear read a little childish, and the cards repeat the same three lines for every person.

A · ALMANAC
Editorial serif, hairline rules, a ledger instead of cards. Leads with the one thing the app never says today: how long he has actually lived. Calm, bookish, suits the obituary-page wit.
Tradeoff: less scannable at a glance, and serif at 15px needs care on older eyes.

B · COUNTDOWN
Dark, one giant number, amber accent. The next milestone becomes the whole screen; the list is a quiet tally underneath. Punchy and celebratory, readable from across the room.
Tradeoff: dark themes are harder for 60+ eyes in daylight, and counting down frames the wait rather than the wins.

C · SCOREBOARD
Lifespans drawn as bars with a dashed line for his age: you can see who he has passed and how far the next one is without reading a date. Theme tiles replace the scrolling chip row (bigger targets, shows counts).
Tradeoff: busiest of the three; ancient figures with rough dates get a misleadingly precise bar.
